test_title: PYST 31: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 24 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The doctor instructed the patient to ______ up and down his house as an exercise.
solution: The correct answer is: **Walk** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Walk **means to move on foot at a regular and fairly slow pace, putting one foot in front of the other in a controlled manner. (नियंत्रित तरीके से एक पैर को दूसरे के सामने रखकर नियमित और काफी धीमी गति से पैदल चलना) • **Example: ***She decided to take a leisurely walk in the park to enjoy the fresh air and nature.* • In this context, "**walk**" is the suitable choice because it implies a controlled and regular movement on foot, which is often recommended as a form of exercise for its cardiovascular and general health benefits. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**. **Complete sentence**: *The doctor instructed the patient to walk __up and down his house as an exercise.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Work: **The effort or activity directed towards a goal or task. (किसी लक्ष्य या कार्य की ओर निर्देशित प्रयास या गतिविधि) • **Chase: **To pursue or follow with the intent of catching or capturing. (पकड़ने या कब्जा करने के इरादे से पीछा करना ) • **Wake: **The state of being awake or the action of waking up. (जागने की अवस्था या क्रिया) 3a:Tafb, The correct answer is "**fresh**".
